# Data Source: appwrite_auth_team

Fetches an Appwrite team by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appwrite_auth_team" "engineers" {
  id = "engineers"
}

output "team_name" {
  value = data.appwrite_auth_team.engineers.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The team ID.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The team creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) The team name.
- `updated_at` (String) The team last update timestamp.
